steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ's buyer Responses screen, which is the subject of the selection action.
Ensure the RFQ response actions, including counter-offer-related controls, are available.
Ensure eRFX project functionality is enabled for the prepared RFQ.
Check that Vendor B's response exposes the quote-selection control.
Initiate selection of Vendor B's quote from the Responses grid.
Set the selected allocation quantity to the required 10 units.
